    Band modules with a scalar twist #

    For a band b and t ∈ kˣ, the band module M(b, t) has V = k and twist t. The vector x₀ = single first 1 lies in the numerator but not the denominator of the pair at first, and its chain around the band returns to t • x₀ (chain_x0). At a primitive band the pair functor at first is one-dimensional (finrank_F_first), spanned by x₀.
